parallel_tolerance_m.description: WRO rule: max wheel-to-wall distance difference

default_max_frames.description: give up after this many control ticks (20s @ 20Hz)

saturated_steer_threshold.description: normalized steering magnitude counted as "at lock"

speed.description: constant driving speed during the maneuver (m/s)

min_lookahead_dist_m.description: floor distance to avoid curvature blow-up

wall_standoff_m.description: closest approach to the field wall

marker_standoff_m.description: closest approach to a parking-bay marker fin

attempt_after_final_lap.description: Pursue the parking bay after the final lap. False ships: the bay is geometrically unreachable and chasing it costs far more than it can pay.

derive_lot_from_in_bay_start.description: Build the parking lot from the start pose when the metadata has none. On, so parking is reachable on hardware.

lot_keep_out_m.description: Extra metres, beyond the fins' own depth and the chassis half-width, the pursuit target is held off the parking lot while driving PAST it: the target's depth from the lot's wall is raised to ParkingLotSpecs.LENGTH + RobotSpecs.WIDTH/2 + this. Acts only inside the lot's along-wall span (widened by half a chassis length), only in the lot's own corridor, never once the park manoeuvre has engaged, and never when it would move the target toward the illegal side of a committed sign -- a wrong-side pass ends the round and a scrape does not. 0.0 disables it.
